strategy.overview: Motor Show links RALLY to Double Scoring, DRAGSTER to ball recovery, and MOTOCROSS or FORMULA 1 to two-ball Multiball. Build RALLY with its three targets and the right loop, then collect it; later right-loop awards advance through 2x, 3x, and 5x, with Extra Ball at 3x. Build DRAGSTER with its targets and the left loop; after collecting it, the video game begins when the ball drains, and a win returns that ball. For Multiball, complete either ramp objective, shoot its lit ramp to lock the ball and begin the video game, then win.
strategy.simpleOverview: Build RALLY at its targets and the right loop to start Double Scoring, and build DRAGSTER at its targets and the left loop for a chance to win back the drained ball. To start Multiball, complete MOTOCROSS or FORMULA 1, shoot that objective's lit ramp, and win its video game.
strategy.summary: Use RALLY for scoring and DRAGSTER for drain protection. Complete either ramp objective, lock at its lit ramp, and win the video game to start two-ball Multiball.

quickInfo.name: Time the Skill Shot
quickInfo.summary: Plunge on green for 100,000; yellow scores 20,000.

quickInfo.name: Build RALLY
quickInfo.summary: Use its targets and the right loop for Double Scoring.

quickInfo.name: Build DRAGSTER
quickInfo.summary: Its video can return the ball after a drain.

quickInfo.name: Start Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Finish a ramp objective, lock at its ramp, and win the video.

steps.text: Time the plunge for the green starting-line lamp to score 100,000; yellow scores 20,000.
Complete RALLY with its three-target bank and right-loop shots, then collect it to start Double Scoring; keep using the right loop to advance its multiplier awards.
Complete DRAGSTER with its three-target bank and left-loop shots; after collecting it, the video starts on the drain, and winning returns the ball to the plunger.
For Multiball, complete MOTOCROSS, shoot the lit left ramp to lock and play its video game, then win to start two-ball Multiball.

alternatives.title: Use FORMULA 1 for Multiball
alternatives.when: Use this when the right ramp is more repeatable than the left ramp.

steps.text: Complete FORMULA 1 with its target bank and right-ramp shots, then shoot the lit right ramp to lock and begin the video game.
Win the Formula 1 video game to start two-ball Multiball.
Collect DRAGSTER and RALLY before exposing the ball to repeated ramp attempts.
Complete and collect MOTOCROSS and FORMULA 1 to finish the four objectives and reach the operator-set Super Special award.

machineSetup: Confirm the easy or hard setting for each video game, ball count, score-award thresholds, Extra Ball conversions, and the operator-set Super Special award.
Test the starting-line lamps, all four target banks, both loops and both ramps, the two video locks, monitor, flipper-button video controls, and ball releases.

techniques.name: Live catch
techniques.instruction: Live-catch a controlled ramp or loop return before choosing the next objective shot.

cautions.issue: The ramp video games can be lost on hard settings.
cautions.response: Check the setup before choosing a Multiball route; a loss returns the locked ball without starting Multiball.
